decisions: Root stale-world-read finding: each open now takes a monotonic request version, and installing a Session is an atomic sessions.compute that refuses to replace a newer session. An older loadedWorlds completion is ignored before it can open a menu or remove the current registration, preserving the newer page's chance refresh.
3.both.1: a missing back layout item keeps the renderer's missing barrier name and lore but is still registered with the back action and original sound, so clicking the barrier returns to the list.

3.both.2 and failed-open fixes 1.both.3/2.both.1: showLoot and showList now render a target state but commit it only after the menu replacement actually lands. Refused, empty, and exceptional opens leave the existing session state untouched, including when a list page turn advanced the revision before failure, so a later chance publication cannot overwrite the still-visible list.
A successful replacement commits its target page while preserving the currently selected list page, so back returns to the page the list was paged to while an open was pending.

1.both.1 remains fixed with weight<0 treated as always before chances arrive; 1.both.2 retains the corrected source:id missing label and one-resolution behavior. The obsolete Missing not_an_item oracle is not used.

Retained the one-resolution changing-source regression as Phase9WikiInfoResolutionProofTest; the first miss stays a missing barrier with Missing changing:book and is not relabelled by a second resolution.
Added in-repo regressions for the stale-world-read race, missing back action, exceptional single failed open, two in-flight failed opens, and list paging during a refused loot open.
